muse-spark-1.3.description: NeuroLink default. Models page (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/models, retrieved 2026-09-29): "muse-spark-1.3 is the default model in the code examples throughout these docs." The page describes it as "the latest version, tuned for agentic workflows (multi-step tool, browser, and long-horizon tasks) with improved coding over 1.2." and says "Recommended for new work." Standard tier; context window 1,048,576 tokens ("Available Muse Spark models" table on the Models page). Price per 1M tokens on https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits: input $1.25, output $4.25, cached input $0.15. maxOutputTokens 131072 is the output figure in the Coding agents guide (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/coding-agents) entry for this model id: "Limits: context = 1048576, output = 131072". vision is true: the "Available Muse Spark models" table on the Models page lists image among its input modalities, and the Image understanding page (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/image-understanding) says "image understanding is fully supported" on Chat Completions.

errorRules.message: Meta Model API rejected the request's authentication (HTTP 401; an unauthenticated GET of /models returned error.code "invalid_api_key" and error.type "authentication_error" on 2026-09-29, and the Error handling page lists 401 Unauthorized: "The API key was missing, invalid, or revoked."). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Create a key: {setupUrl}

Meta Model API returned HTTP 402 (the Error handling page lists 402 Payment Required: "The request cannot be completed due to a billing issue.", with an example body whose error.code is "billing_not_configured").
Meta Model API returned HTTP 403 (the Error handling page lists 403 Forbidden: "The API key does not have permission to access the requested resource.").
Meta Model API returned HTTP 429 (the Error handling page lists 429 Too Many Requests: "Your team has exceeded the rate limit.").
Meta Model API reported model {model} as not found (the Error handling page says "an unknown model returns model_not_found").

instructions: 1. Visit: https://dev.meta.ai/ — the page carries a "Start building" button whose link target is /api/auth/login

2. Create an API key: the Authentication page (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/authentication) lists the steps "Log in and open the API keys tab.", "Click Create API key, give it a descriptive name, and click Create." and "Copy the key right away. You only see it once."

3. Authentication is a Bearer token: the Authentication page says "Pass the key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header:", and the Error handling page (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/error-handling) lists "Malformed API key (not in LLM|{id}|{secret} format)" as a cause of HTTP 401

4. Billing as the vendor states it: the Pricing page (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits) says "You pay only for what you use." and the Authentication and billing page (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/auth) says "Meta Model API billing is usage-based: you're billed for the tokens your requests consume."
5. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} in your .env file (the vendor's examples read MODEL_API_KEY, which NeuroLink does not)
setup.description: Docs-verified only: the vendor's GET https://api.meta.ai/v1/models needs a key (an unauthenticated GET on 2026-09-29 answered HTTP 401), so the five model ids come from the Models page (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/models, retrieved 2026-09-29) and the roster has not been checked; the entry is not yet live-verified. OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.meta.ai/v1: the Chat Completions page (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/protocols/chat-completions) says "The endpoint is OpenAI-compatible" and "The response matches the OpenAI chat completions shape.", and the Overview (https://dev.meta.ai/docs/overview) says "Model API is drop-in compatible with the OpenAI SDK, the Anthropic SDK, and OpenAI-compatible agent CLIs." The catalog holds the five model ids of the "Available Muse Spark models" table on the Models page (Standard tier: muse-spark-1.3, muse-spark-1.2, muse-spark-1.1; Contributor tier: muse-spark-1.3-contributor, muse-spark-1.2-contributor); the Chat Completions page says "Chat Completions serves the Muse Spark text models." The Models page lists muse-image-1.0, muse-voice-transcribe-1.0 and sam-3.1 in separate per-family tables; they are not in the catalog. models.fallbacks lists the Standard-tier ids; the Contributor-tier ids are in models.catalog and models.topModels. apiKeyFormat follows the Error handling page's "LLM|{id}|{secret} format". models.defaultContextWindow (1048576) is the context window the Overview and Models pages state for the Muse Spark models; models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (16384) is a NeuroLink placeholder the vendor does not publish. The status field of the five models holds production, a placeholder for a value the catalog schema requires; it is not a vendor statement. billingPolicy no-free-tier is a schema placeholder (the schema has no unknown value), not a vendor statement. Verification level: docs-verified, not yet live-verified.
